description:
Structured output produced by the judge for a single criterion.

This is the schema sent to the LLM via `output_format`; keep it small and stable.

score.description: Score on the 0-5 scale defined by the rubric
score.title: Score

rationale.description: Short justification grounded on the conversation
rationale.title: Rationale

evidence.description: Literal excerpts copied verbatim from the conversation
evidence.title: Evidence

title: CriterionGrade
